Historical revenue per dollar of green-fee revenue

Source: R/revenue.R
revenue_relationships.Rd

Each ratio is a sum of one category divided by the sum of green fees on the rows where both amounts are present. It is not the average of daily ratios. Rows with a missing category drop out of that category only. Revenue on zero-round days stays in the sums.

Usage

revenue_relationships(data, by = c("all", "year", "month_of_year"))

Arguments

data

A golfops_rounds table or a golfops_course_revenue table.

by

all, year, or month_of_year.

Value

A tibble with one row per category and period.

Details

A green-fee denominator of zero makes the ratio unavailable. The result is missing, not zero and not infinity. The ratio is a historical relationship between recorded revenue categories. It is not a causal multiplier and not spending per golfer.

The input may be prepared Dobson rows or a course_revenue() table. A revenue table does not need a participation file.

Examples

revenue_relationships(dobson_operating_daily(), by = "year")
